name: Feature request

## Use case

Describe the problem you need to solve and who is affected. Link related issues
or roadmap items if available.

## Proposed behavior

Describe what a user should be able to do. Include a small API or workflow example
if it helps explain the request.

## Alternatives

Describe existing approaches or workarounds and what they cannot address.

## Scope and compatibility

Identify any expected effects on public APIs, RPC wire behavior, capability
authority, storage formats, supported platforms, or performance. Mark unknowns
as unknown; an implementation design is not required to request a feature.

## Acceptance criteria

Describe an observable outcome or test that would establish that the request is
complete.
